note:
Replacement hero for /pages/reviews: three women friends laughing together, close on their faces. One Black woman, one blonde, one brunette, as Malcolm asked 2026-08-26.

DIMENSIONS ARE THE TARGET THIS TIME, NOT AN AFTERTHOUGHT. Malcolm asked for the right size for the banner, and the right size is measured, not guessed: the section is Impact's image-with-text-overlay at `content-over-media--sm`, full-bleed, which theme.css sets to a FIXED 375/400/440px height with object-fit cover. Box aspect is therefore viewport/440 - 3.27:1 at 1440, 4.36:1 at 1920. Masters are briefed at 5280x1200 (4.400:1), just past the 1920 case, so nothing is cropped vertically on a normal desktop and the surplus width is croppable margin at narrower windows.

The two previous rounds were briefed at 3:1 and the theme ate 46% of the height, cutting the smile off the live page. Wording could not fix that because the engines cannot see the box. Briefing the true aspect is the fix; scripts/reframe-banner-to-box.py remains the fallback for any candidate that still needs it.

COST OF THE TRUE ASPECT: gpt-image hard-refuses anything past 3:1 with a 400, so it cannot run here. It is covered by the sibling config reviews-hero-three-friends-gpt.json at 3:1, generated from these exact prompts, so rule 1 still holds - every brief reaches every supplier. NBP snaps to its nearest named ratio (21:9) and Luma to 16:9 whatever they are asked for; their candidates come back narrower and are judged on face and feeling, then reframed if one wins.

WHERE THE TEXT GOES. The headline is CENTRED and white over a 40% #1A1A1A overlay. Three faces spread evenly across a 4.4:1 frame would put the middle face directly behind it. So in three of the four slots the group is clustered into one half of the frame and the other half falls to deep graphite - the same device that worked on the single-face hero now live. Slot 3 deliberately breaks that to test the spread-across composition, with the tonal centre held even; it is the risky one and is briefed as such.

EXACTLY THREE. Engines add a fourth head, merge two into one, or give everyone the same face. Each prompt states the three women separately with distinct skin, hair and position, and the negatives name every failure mode. Hands are negated outright: friends laughing together reach for each other, and hands at this scale come back malformed.

AGES 30-45 per Malcolm's standing answer, stated per person so nobody defaults to twenty-five.

slots.title: Three friends clustered right, laughing at each other, graphite left
slots.prompt: Extremely wide cinematic close-up photograph of exactly three women friends laughing together, in a frame four and a half times wider than it is tall. The three heads are clustered close together in the right half of the picture, cheeks almost touching, at slightly different heights so they form a loose diagonal rather than a row. On the left of the group is a Black woman about thirty eight years old with deep brown skin and dark natural coiled hair; in the middle a woman about thirty four years old with fair skin and warm blonde hair falling loose; on the right a woman about forty two years old with light olive skin and dark brown hair. All three are laughing openly and genuinely at something one of them has just said, mouths open with upper teeth showing, cheeks lifted, eyes creased almost shut - the Black woman is turned toward the other two, the blonde woman has her head tipped back mid-laugh, and the brunette is looking across at them. Their heads reach about three quarters of the frame height with their eyes just above the middle of the picture and their mouths just below it, so every face sits inside the central band; the top of the frame carries only hair and shadow and the bottom only shoulders in soft dark clothing. The entire left half of the picture, running to the left edge, the top edge and the bottom edge, is a deep graphite grey ground, colour #1A1A1A, dark, smooth and completely even in tone with nothing in it. One soft directional light from the upper right wraps across all three faces and falls away toward the left. Skin is real, radiant and finely textured on each of them - healthy and luminous, with fine down catching the light and the natural creases that real laughter makes at the eyes and cheeks present and lit rather than erased. Very shallow depth of field with the middle face critically sharp, fine film grain, editorial, warm, unposed, intimate.
slots.negative_extra: faces evenly spread across the frame, subjects in a straight row, group on the left, object or texture in the left background, gradient background, all three the same skin tone, all three the same hair colour, closed lips, faint smile, looking at the camera

slots.title: Three friends spread across the full width, tonal centre held even

On the left a Black woman about thirty six years old with deep brown skin and dark natural coiled hair, laughing with her head turned toward the centre; in the middle a woman about forty one years old with light olive skin and dark brown hair, set slightly further back from the camera and softer in focus, laughing with her eyes creased shut; on the right a woman about thirty three years old with fair skin and warm blonde hair, laughing toward the middle woman. Through the middle of the picture the tone is held quiet and even - the middle woman is further back, in soft shadow and gentle focus, so that band of the frame stays smooth and unbroken with no bright highlight or hard edge crossing it, while the two outer faces carry the light. One soft directional light from above and slightly right wraps across all three. Skin is real, radiant and finely textured on each of them - healthy and luminous, with fine down and the creases of real laughter at the eyes and cheeks present and lit rather than erased. Very shallow depth of field, fine film grain, editorial, warm, unposed, intimate.

slots.title: Cheek to cheek, heads stacked on a diagonal, group right
slots.prompt: Extremely wide cinematic close-up photograph of exactly three women friends pressed cheek to cheek and laughing, in a frame four and a half times wider than it is tall. The three heads are packed tightly together in the right third of the picture and stacked on a steep diagonal - the lowest head nearest the bottom right, the highest toward the upper right corner - so they read as one close cluster rather than three separate portraits. The lowest is a woman about forty three years old with light olive skin and dark brown hair; the middle a Black woman about thirty five years old with deep brown skin and dark natural hair; the highest a woman about thirty one years old with fair skin and warm blonde hair. All three are laughing hard together, mouths open with upper teeth showing, eyes creased almost shut, faces close enough that their cheeks touch. Their eyes sit just above the middle of the picture and their mouths just below it, so the faces are held inside the central band, with hair and shadow above and dark clothing below. The left two thirds of the picture, running to the left edge, the top edge and the bottom edge, is a deep graphite grey ground, colour #1A1A1A, dark, smooth and completely even in tone with nothing in it. One soft directional light from the right rakes gently across the stacked faces so the nearest is brightest and the furthest falls into shadow. Skin is real, radiant and finely textured on each of them - healthy and luminous, with fine down and the creases of real laughter present and lit rather than erased. Very shallow depth of field with the middle face sharp, fine film grain, editorial, warm, joyful, intimate.
